analysis.summary: The project is a simple Todo API built with Flask, utilizing an in-memory data store with Python dataclasses. It provides full CRUD operations for todos, including filtering by completion status. The application logic is contained within a single app.py file alongside a supporting models.py module.
components: app.py: Defines the Flask application instance, in-memory store instance, and all HTTP route handlers for managing todos.
models.py: Defines the Todo dataclass and the TodoStore class for in-memory data management.
risks: app.py line 54: app.run(debug=True) should be removed in favor of running with uvicorn main:app.

steps.title: Migrate data models
steps.description: Migrate models.py to use Pydantic models for request and response validation.
steps.notes: Migrated Todo dataclass to Pydantic models (TodoBase, TodoCreate, TodoUpdate, Todo) for request and response validation in FastAPI, and updated TodoStore to handle these models accordingly.

steps.title: Migrate Todo routes to FastAPI
steps.description: Migrate app.py to main.py using FastAPI, implementing GET /todos, POST /todos, GET /todos/{todo_id}, PUT /todos/{todo_id}, and DELETE /todos/{todo_id}.
steps.notes: Migrated app.py from Flask to FastAPI in main.py. Implemented Pydantic models for request validation and updated route handlers to use FastAPI idioms such as path parameters, query parameters, HTTPException, and status codes.
